coverage.title: There is an abandonware game I loved as a kid called Rescue Raiders. I asked Claude to create a modern & updated version of the game with new graphics, goals, tech trees, etc. It iterated back-and-forth with critic & art agents until I got this. Its fun! rescue-raiders.netlify.app
